text:
sam: noticed a small burst of checksum errors on local nvme after yesterday's peering flap. janitor rewalked metadata and requeued a bunch of tempfiles. impact: a handful of nodes in eu-west2 saw higher iops and some attach backpressure.

lee: which metric spiked? scrub retries or metadata-read-errors?

ops-bot: ALERT: nvme-checksum-drift pool=scratch-eu-west2 devices=4 spike=2024-08-02T03:12Z error_type=metadata_checksum

carla: quick look: `nvme_dev_errors_total{type="checksum",pool="scratch-eu-west2"}` shows 4 devices with ~120 errors over 30m. scrub backlog increased ~4000 files.

paul: topology note: the affected devices are all on node-group eu-west2-c (older flash batch). spare_threshold for that pool is 6 devices remaining.

sam: Risk: janitor will try to quarantine/reassign extents which will trigger eviction on ~12 nodes if we let it run at full speed. That could cascade into gpu attach holds.

lee: Proposal: pause janitor reassign for that pool for 90m, throttle scrub concurrency, and enable read-only fallback for extents flagged with checksum mismatch. We must avoid killing attach throughput.

carla: Agree. Also open a short-lived scheduler policy: prefer attach to nodes with free ephemeral on newer-batch nodes. I can push a patch to the scheduler.

paul: Procurement/ops: if we drain any nodes we'll need spares. How many hot spares do we have in eu-west2?

ops-bot: POOL_STATE: scratch-eu-west2 free_spares=8 hot_spares=3 total_devices=512

paul: Ok spares look ok for a small canary, but not for a mass drain. Keep drains limited to <=4 nodes at a time.

carla: I'm going to set janitor.rate_limit=50 (ops units) for the pool and scrub.maxParallel=1. Pushing change now:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/pool-scratch-eu-west2 --patch '{"data":{"janitor.rate_limit":"50","scrub.maxParallel":"1"}}'
```

ops-bot: NOTE: configmap patch applied (r235). Janitor workers acknowledged new rate.

lee: Scheduler rule deployed to prefer nodes: `node.os_image: flash-batch-2` for job.priority<30 (non-prod). Deploy: https://git.internal/sched/roll/7810

sam: Finance flag: if we shift non-prod to other regions for 6+ hours, cost delta could be ~8%. @finance-bot please post threshold alert if diversion > 6h.

finance-bot: Configured: alert if regional diversion cost_estimate > 5% and duration > 6h. Webhook -> #costs.

sre-oncall: Monitoring iops and attach latency. If checksum errors persist after 90m we'll start a 4-node canary drain to replace devices. Notify hw-ops to stage replacements.

carla: INF ticket INF-4601 opened (nvme-checksum-drift-euw2). Included logs, grafana link, spare counts, and replacement ETA request.

sam: I'll add an automated check to block full janitor quarantine if attach_slo > 250ms for pool. If attach latency crosses that, janitor will be forced to backoff.

lee: Good call. Can we also add a temporary alert to paging if more than 6 devices in any one node report checksum>50 in 1h? Paging to hw-ops.

ops-bot: ALERT RULE CREATED: checksum_burst_thresh -> page hw-ops on cross-node device burst >6 in 1h.

paul: Standby: I'll coordinate with hw-ops for replacement drive procurement and set up canary swap plan (replace -> rebuild -> verify) for up to 8 nodes.

sam: Thanks. We'll reconvene in 60m with updated metrics. Post any logs to INF-4601.

carla: Uploading first scrub snapshot to the ticket now.

sre-oncall: Watching metrics: attach latency currently stable. No pager yet.

sam: nice. keep updates short in this thread. :eyes:
